title: Eye of Sargeras
wikitext:
{{Stub}}[[Image:Eye of Sargeras.jpg|thumb|The Eye of Sargeras as seen in Warcraft 3: The Frozen Throne]]An artifact found in the [[Tomb of Sargeras]] by [[Illidan Stormrage]].  The artifact was sought by both Illidan and [[Gul'dan]], the former gaining it only through the aid of the [[Naga]], the latter being torn apart by crazed demons. We don't know if the Eye was Sargeras's actual eye, or simply an artifact which held his power after the battle with [[Aegwynn]].

Eye of Sargeras was used by Illidan in an attempt to destroy the [[Frozen Throne]], but the intervention of [[Malfurion]] and [[Maiev]] destroyed the Eye instead. We can only hope its powers did not survive.
